business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fiduciary Administration of Irrevocable Offshore Spendthrift Trusts

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: South Korea (Republic of Korea; unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Free Trade Agreement between the Republic of Korea and the United States of America
Free Trade Agreement between the European Union and its Member States and the Republic of Korea
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Korea and the Government of the People's Republic of China on the Promotion and Protection of Investments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Act on Reporting and Use of Specific Financial Transaction Information (Specific Financial Information Act, Act No. 1061, as amended) and its Enforcement Decree; Financial Transaction Reports Act (Act No. 1061, as amended); Commercial Act (Act No. 1000, as amended); Trust Act (Act No. 10924, as amended); Framework Act on National Taxes; and FATF Recommendations as implemented by the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit. For a Yuhan Hoesa, the beneficial owner is any natural person ultimately owning or controlling at least 25 percent of the entity, any natural person with actual control through other means, and for a discretionary trust, the settlor, trustee, protector, and each named or contingent beneficiary class. These UBO data are reported to the Korean FIU and financial institutions but are not published in the commercial registry.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign settlor, corporate parent, or shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of Companies or competent companies registrar in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A for Hague Apostille Convention member states: notarize the certificate, obtain an Apostille from the competent domestic authority, attach a certified Korean translation. Path B for non-Apostille states: obtain domestic authenticity certification from the origin state ministry of foreign affairs, then present the certificate to the Korean Embassy or Consulate in that origin state for consular legalization, and attach a certified Korean translation. The two paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; they must never be chained sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or competent tax authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A: Hague Apostille issued by the designated authority in the origin state, followed by certified Korean translation. Path B: consular legalization at the Korean Embassy or Consulate for non-Apostille states, followed by certified Korean translation. Apostille and consular legalization are mutually exclusive and must never be combined.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney authorizing formation of the Korean Yuhan Hoesa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly convened board of directors or sole shareholder of the foreign parent or settlor entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A: notarize the board resolution and power of attorney before a notary in the origin state, then affix the Hague Apostille, and attach a certified Korean translation. Path B: notarize the document, obtain origin-state foreign ministry certification, then submit to the Korean consular post for consular legalization, and attach a certified Korean translation. No sequence may combine Apostille and consular legalization.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association (Memorandum and Articles of Association) of the foreign entity and proposed Korean Articles of Association of the Yuhan Hoesa
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign entity corporate secretary and the Korean formation attorney, with signature certification by a Korean notary for the Korean Articles
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: For the foreign entity articles: use either Hague Apostille for member states or consular legalization for non-member states, then attach certified Korean translation. For the proposed Korean Articles of Association, which are drafted in English with an official Korean convention, no foreign legalization is required, but signatures must be notarized in Korea. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel and mutually exclusive.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter and Signature Specimen from the foreign beneficial owner, settlor, or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: International bank maintaining the referrer relationship and duly authorized bank officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A: notarize the bank officer signature and obtain an Apostille from the state where the bank is located, then provide certified Korean translation. Path B: notarize and obtain origin foreign ministry certification, then complete Korean consular legalization, followed by certified Korean translation. Apostille and consular legalization cannot be applied in sequence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Registers of Directors and Members of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registered corporate agent or legal representative of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A: certification by the corporate agent or law firm, notarization, Hague Apostille by the competent origin-state authority, and certified Korean translation. Path B: notarization, origin foreign ministry certification, Korean consular legalization, and certified Korean translation. The two paths are mutually exclusive and must not be chained.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all applicants, shareholders, directors, settlors, protectors, named and contingent beneficiaries, trustees and agents against (i) FATF, OFAC SDN, UN Security Council consolidated list, EU/UK and Korean FIU-designated persons; (ii) domestic Korean sanctions under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act; (iii) global PEP databases plus close associates and family members. Each natural person must be screened at onboarding and refreshed every 90 calendar days. Automated batch screening with full-width character, phonetic/fuzzy matching and name-only matches must be escalated to the AML compliance officer. Any positive hit, unresolved false positive, or PEP status requires enhanced due diligence, obtaining senior management approval, and filing a suspicious transaction report with the Korean Financial Intelligence Unit before incorporating the Yuhan Hoesa.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Internet Registration Office (iRO) maintained by the Supreme Court of Korea, supplemented by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy trade-name consultation for sensitive financial terms and the Korean Intellectual Property Office trademark search database for conflicting marks
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under the Korean Commercial Act, the corporate name must be recorded in Hangul and, for this entity type, must include the Korean-language corporate designation corresponding to 'Yuhan Hoesa' or limited liability company. An English trade name may be registered as a supplementary external name for cross-border contracts, but it does not replace the statutory Hangul trade name. The four-tier naming convention consists of (1) the Hangul trade name, (2) the registered business purpose, (3) the registered head office address, and (4) the company registration number. Foreign investor names must be transliterated phonetically in accordance with the National Language Institute romanization and transliteration standards, and the proposed name must not be confusingly identical or similar to any pre-registered Korean trade name for the same or similar business scope.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name clearance is rejected, the applicant or registered agent must first request a written statement of grounds from the registry judge. Within fourteen days of receiving the rejection, the applicant must file a written appeal or objection under the Non-Contentious Litigation Procedures Act with the same registry court. The objection must attach the rejected application, the pre-search report, the proposed amended name, and a legal memorandum on distinctiveness and non-confusion with existing registered names. If the registry court sustains the rejection, the applicant may then institute an administrative lawsuit before the relevant High Court under the Administrative Litigation Act, and the appeal must be prosecuted by a Korean-licensed attorney with a duly executed power of attorney.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not permissible for this ISIC 6430 trust-administration entity as a stand-alone arrangement. The National Tax Service, the Financial Services Commission, the Korean FIU, and prospective Korean banks collectively require a physical registered office where the actual management, books, records, and compliance function are maintained. For the high-risk special license category applicable to fiduciary administration and asset protection trusts, a serviced office will be accepted only if it is a dedicated physical suite under an executed lease of at least twelve months, with a visible company plaque, full-time administration staff, a fixed landline, physical vault or file room, and access to original documents. A virtual mailbox alone will expose the entity to business license denial, bank account refusal, and recharacterization as a sham office by the tax authority.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High risk, quantified at approximately 75 to 80 percent within the first fiscal year. Unannounced inspections may be performed by the National Tax Service under the Framework Act on National Taxes and by the Financial Services Commission and Korean FIU under the Specific Financial Information Act. Inspection checklist: (1) physical signboard or office plaque at the registered address; (2) original lease agreement and utility bills; (3) presence of full-time employees and payroll records; (4) corporate bank and trust account transaction records; (5) trust asset register and minutes of trustee decisions; (6) existing server and email infrastructure; (7) original company seal and notarial records; (8) visitor and mail logs. Failure to maintain a genuine physical office will result in revocation of any financial or trust authorization, refusal of corporate tax registration, and criminal liability for false registration.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Supreme Court Registration Office and competent municipal government
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the Local Tax Act and the Litigation Fees Act plus prevailing fixed corporate counsel fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule and market benchmark for certified translation and legalization handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Korean Articles of Association, board resolution, power of attorney, and signature specimens for the Yuhan Hoesa incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Korean notary public and formation attorney
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary Fee Act tariff and standard Korean incorporation legal fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical registered office and commercial substance setup for a full twelve-month initial term, including suitable serviced office suite and corporate plaque

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Seoul/Sejong Grade-A serviced office market rate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO/AML/CTF compliance onboarding, PEP and sanctions screening software subscription, and Korean AML compliance officer support for the first year

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for Korean KYC/UBO screening platforms and compliance officer retainer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Financial Services Commission and Korean FIU pre-clearance readiness assessment for the trust business special license prerequisite
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Korean external counsel specialized in FSC licensing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee benchmark for FSC licensing readiness and regulatory gap analysis before formal application

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea (Act No. 8581, as amended), particularly Articles 287 (incorporation), 292 (articles of incorporation), 295 (promoters' subscription), 318 (registration of incorporation), 319 (effective date of incorporation), 376 (executive directors); Trust Act (Act No. 10924), Article 34; Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act (Act No. 10511), Articles 12 and 31 for trust business license.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Registration Section, Civil Registry Office of the District Court having territorial jurisdiction over the registered office of the company in the Republic of Korea.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation together with an Application for Registration of Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company (Company Establishment Registration Application).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital is required for forming a Yuhan Hoesa under the Commercial Act. However, because the company will apply for a Trust Business License to administer irrevocable discretionary asset protection trusts, the Financial Services Commission requires a minimum paid-in capital of Korean Won 10,000,000,000 (approximately US Dollar 7,400,000). This amount must be deposited in a blocked escrow account at a licensed Korean bank and remain impounded until regulatory approval is obtained. A certificate of the escrow deposit must be submitted with the trust business license application.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF YUHAN HOESA (LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY) ADOPTED IN SEOUL, REPUBLIC OF KOREA, ON THE ______ DAY OF ______ 2025. WHEREAS the undersigned incorporators have caused the Company to be incorporated under the Commercial Act of the Republic of Korea, and WHEREAS the registered capital has been subscribed and the initial executive directors have been lawfully appointed, and WHEREAS the Board must now establish the corporate governance and operational framework for the fiduciary administration of irrevocable discretionary asset protection trusts. NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED as follows: FIRST, the Company ratifies and confirms the execution and registration of its Articles of Incorporation, the payment of all incorporation fees, and the commencement of the Company's separate legal personality from the date of registration. SECOND, the Board authorizes the issuance of the entire subscribed share capital, consisting of the paid-in capital deposited into the blocked escrow account held in the Company's name at a licensed Korean commercial bank, and directs the executive director to execute all share certificates and maintain the share register. THIRD, the Board adopts the registered office located at the address stated in the Articles of Incorporation in Seoul, Republic of Korea, and authorizes the executive director to execute a lease agreement, install relevant corporate signage, and display all required regulatory certificates. FOURTH, the Board authorizes the opening of corporate transaction and fiduciary trust custody accounts at a bank licensed to conduct foreign exchange and fiduciary business in Korea, and designates the following individual signatories for operational banking: the chief executive officer and the chief compliance officer, to act jointly for any transaction exceeding US Dollar 50,000 and singly for smaller transactions. FIFTH, the Board appoints the following statutory officers: [Name] as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director, [Name] as Chief Compliance Officer, and [Name] as Anti-Money-Laundering Officer, each holding office for a term as specified in the Articles of Incorporation and having full authority to execute all statutory filings, regulatory correspondence, and disclosure obligations to the Financial Services Commission, the Financial Supervisory Service, and the National Tax Service. SIXTH, the Board directs the appointed officers to develop and implement internal control systems, a corporate governance policy, an anti-money-laundering and counter-financing-of-terrorism program, and a risk management manual, all to be effective before the filing of the Trust Business License application. SEVENTH, the Board authorizes external legal counsel to prepare and submit all necessary applications for the Trust Business License to the Financial Services Commission within five business days of adoption of this resolution, and any director is authorized to provide such incidental approvals as may be necessary. THIS RESOLUTION is effective as of the date of adoption and supersedes any prior conflicting instruction. ADOPTED unanimously by the First Board of Directors of Yuhan Hoesa, Limited Liability Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation with Escrow Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A Notary Public duly commissioned in the Republic of Korea and a licensed Korean commercial bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Incorporation in English and Korean, setting out the company name as Yuhan Hoesa (Limited Liability Company), the precise object of fiduciary administration of irrevocable discretionary asset protection trusts, the registered office address in Seoul, the total authorized share capital, the number of shares, and the initial executive directors. Ensure the commercial model is limited strictly to discrete asset protection fiduciary management. Deliver the draft instruments to the Notary Public for notarization and have all founding shareholders appear to acknowledge signature before the notary. Concurrently, open a blocked escrow account in the name of the proposed company at a supervised bank, deposit the prescribed minimum paid-in capital of Korean Won 10,000,000,000, and obtain a bank certificate evidencing the deposit and its blocked status. No corporate activities may commence prior to incorporation registration.
required_dossiers: Draft Articles of Incorporation in English and Korean
Notarized consents to appointment of executive directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary Public raises an objection to the articles due to the trust object clause, revise the object clause to conform to the Trust Act and the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act and re-submit within five business days. If the escrow bank refuses issuance of the blocked balance certificate, select an alternative licensed bank and provide the corrected certificate before proceeding.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration of Incorporation with the District Court
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registration Section of the Seoul Central District Court or another District Court within the jurisdiction of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Application for Registration of Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company with the competent registry using the official court form. Submit the notarized Articles of Incorporation, the paid-in capital escrow certificate, the list of subscribers and their subscription payments, and the board resolution appointing directors and statutory auditors. Pay the registration fee and stamp tax. The court registrar reviews the documents for compliance with the Korean Commercial Act and issues the Certificate of Registration. Once the registration is completed, the Yuhan Hoesa becomes a separate legal person. Brokers or local counsel may submit via the electronic court system on behalf of the company after executing a power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Subscribers personal details and payment evidence
Board resolution appointing executive directors and auditors
Power of attorney if filing via agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a correction order, cure the noted deficiency within fourteen business days, amend the relevant documentation and resubmit. If the registration is suspended or rejected, file an appeal to the court within seven days; alternatively, deregister and commence a fresh incorporation if the defect is substantive.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Tax Registration and Municipal Occupational Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Division of the National Tax Service and the local municipal office of Seoul Metropolitan Government, including the jurisdictional fire department for occupancy safety.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within fifteen business days after the court registration, submit the corporate business commencement tax registration application to the National Tax Service, attaching the incorporation certificate and corporate registration certificate. Obtain the corporate tax identification number and the business registration certificate. If the company leases any physical office space for fiduciary administration, secure an occupancy certificate, a basic fire safety inspection certificate from the jurisdictional fire station, and a structural load confirmation for floor areas exceeding two hundred square meters. This step establishes the company as a registered taxpayer and satisfies basic occupational and municipal safety prerequisites before the trust license application.
required_dossiers: Identification and residence certificates of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Tax Service queries the application due to a mismatch in address or corporate purpose, provide an explanatory letter, amend the registration details, and resubmit within five business days. If the municipal fire department identifies deficiencies in fire safety equipment, perform the required remediation and re-inspection within ten business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trust Business License Application for Fiduciary Asset Protection Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Financial Services Commission of the Republic of Korea, with examination conducted by the Financial Supervisory Service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application for a Trust Business License under Article 12 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act, covering the intended fiduciary administration of irrevocable discretionary asset protection trusts. The application must include the audited financial statements evidencing the paid-in capital of Korean Won 10,000,000,000, a detailed business plan, a comprehensive anti-money-laundering and counter-financing-of-terrorism manual, internal control and risk management policies, fit and proper documentation for each director and compliance officer, and a statement of regulatory non-opposition from the Financial Supervisory Service. The Financial Supervisory Service performs an on-site examination of the office, management qualifications, and compliance systems. After the approval, the Financial Services Commission issues the Trust Business License and the company becomes authorized to administer discretionary asset protection trusts under the Trust Act. No further physical manufacturing or chemical licensing is relevant to this financial fiduciary business model.
required_dossiers: Audited financial statements and escrow capital certificate
Business plan for asset protection trust administration
Fit-and-proper documents for executives and compliance officers
Certificates of corporate registration and tax registration
Office lease and fire safety inspection certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Financial Services Commission requests corrective measures, address the written deficiencies within the stated review period and submit a supplemental response. If the application is rejected or subject to a contested administrative order, the company may file an administrative appeal to the Financial Services Commission, a general administrative court appeal under the Administrative Litigation Act within ninety days, or a parallel amendment and re-filing if the defect is curable.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Services Commission and Financial Supervisory Service; for office occupancy safety, the Seoul Metropolitan Fire and Disaster Prevention Headquarters.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Trust Business License under the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act, together with Corporate Business Registration and Office Occupancy Fire Safety Certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable - no physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing facility. This is a purely fiduciary trust administration business under ISIC 6430.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from the Korean Environmental Impact Assessment Act because no physical construction, land alteration, discharge, or hazardous material handling is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable; no wastewater discharge, volatile organic compound emissions, or hazardous waste generation. The only environmental compliance is ordinary office waste disposal in accordance with municipal waste management regulations, and if servers are used, energy consumption reporting under the Green House Gas and Energy Target Management Scheme is only relevant if annual energy consumption exceeds statutory thresholds.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Occupancy of the leased office requires a basic fire safety inspection certificate from the local fire station, a structural load approval for commercially occupied floor area above 200 square meters, and registration under the Occupational Safety and Health Act for non-manufacturing office premises. The company must install certified fire extinguishers, emergency exits, and a business safety management plan signed by an occupational safety coordinator.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: National Tax Service (NTS) of the Republic of Korea; online electronic portal: HomeTax (www.hometax.go.kr)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign non-resident entity must first appoint a domestic tax representative in Korea, then file a business registration application with the competent district tax office having jurisdiction over its Korean place of business. The application is submitted under the Framework Act on National Taxes and the Value-Added Tax Act, accompanied by the foreign entity's certificate of incorporation, articles of incorporation, power of attorney for the tax representative, domestic lease agreement for the registered place of business, and identification documents of the director or foreign responsible person. After authentication of identity and submission via HomeTax or via in-person filing, the NTS issues a Business Registration Number (TIN/VAT ID). The procurement procedure may also be performed through the tax representative using a certified certificate (GPKI or accredited digital certificate).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Korean domestic tax law does not offer check-the-box or pass-through elections for a Yuhan Hoesa. However, tax treaty tie-breaker and hybrid mismatch rules under the OECD BEPS Action 2 alignment are applied, with mandatory anti-arbitrage adjustments.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value-Added Tax Act
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold for mandatory VAT registration; any business making taxable supplies in Korea must register before commencing activities. A simplified taxpayer regime is available only for small traders with annual taxable turnover up to KRW 80 million.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: VAT e-Tax Invoice issuance is mandatory and must be submitted to the NTS through the HomeTax system in real time. VAT-registered businesses are required to use the electronic tax invoice API or the secure HomeTax web interface; transactions must be authenticated with an accredited digital certificate. The system performs real-time clearance of e-Tax Invoices with NTS. Cash receipts under the Cash Receipts Act must also be issued to resident consumers for transactions exceeding the statutory threshold. No independent anti-fraud digital stamping protocol is used; the NTS database serves as the central fiscal repository.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and certain services qualify for zero-rated VAT relief. Goods must be physically shipped from Korea to a foreign country and supported by an export customs declaration. Offshore digital content, game-related services, and fiduciary asset protection services supplied to non-resident foreign beneficiaries qualify as zero-rated services when the service is rendered to a non-resident, consumption occurs outside Korea, and the consideration is earned in convertible foreign currency. Zero-rating also applies where services are supplied to a foreign business and paid in foreign currency under the statutory exception for export services in the Value-Added Tax Act and its Enforcement Decree.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export Customs Declaration (Export Cargo Clearance Report) submitted through Korea Customs Service UNI-PASS
Bill of Lading (ocean) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing physical exportation from Korea
Foreign Currency Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 credit advice issued by a Korean foreign exchange bank
Cross-border trust administration or offshore asset protection service contract showing the non-resident recipient and foreign-currency settlement terms
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The NTS may conduct a retrospective audit of zero-rating claims within the statutory five-year prescriptive period. Taxpayers must produce the complete export documentation bundle and foreign exchange receipt evidence; failure to do so triggers a reassessment at the standard 10% VAT rate plus statutory penalties. Negligent misreporting carries penalties of 20% of the understated VAT, while intentional fraud attracts a 40% penalty, additional late-payment interest, and referral to criminal prosecution under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act. False or fabricated customs documentation may also lead to customs penalties and forfeiture of Zero-Rating relief.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bank of Korea; foreign exchange administration delegated to the Ministry of Economy and Finance under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, with Korea Customs Service monitoring trade settlement flows
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: South Korea generally maintains full current-account convertibility for ordinary trade, services, and profits; exporters and foreign investors may move trade-related foreign currency freely through a registered foreign exchange bank. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment into a Yuhan Hoesa and settlement of a discretionary trust, are not completely free: investment subscriptions must be routed through a certified foreign exchange bank, reported under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act and the Foreign Investment Promotion Act, and ordinary loans or derivative positions may require prior registration or approval. Foreign-invested companies may remit dividends and disposed proceeds after tax clearance using purpose codes 110121 or 110122, but the bank will demand certification of the foreign investment report, annual audited financial statements, and a tax payment confirmation. The Korean won is not convertible outside the country and non-residents cannot freely open won accounts without a licensed bank, so all repatriation must be executed inside Korea. Although there are no mandatory surrender requirements for export proceeds, the capital account remains carefully policed; transfer pricing documentation, CRS/FATCA filings, and FETA reporting are compulsory. Practical hurdles include slow approval for large settlements, evidentiary burdens for beneficial owners, and the risk of punitive customs or foreign-exchange fines if the incorrect purpose code is used.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, exporters must settle proceeds of exports through a designated foreign exchange bank and obtain an export receipt within one year from the date of export declaration; extensions to two years are available with approval. There is no mandatory statutory conversion ratio; the exporter may maintain a foreign-currency deposit, but any conversion to Korean won must be executed by a licensed foreign exchange bank and matched to a specific export declaration through Korea Customs Service data. This one-year rule is a collection limitation rather than a forced surrender duty.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operational Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operational Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operational Currency Account
Capital Escrow Account and Basic Operational Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low - legally not viable as a stand-alone treasury solution. Offshore digital EMIs without a Korean foreign exchange bank license cannot lawfully maintain fiduciary trust accounts, receive foreign direct investment escrow, or execute won settlement for this entity. Only financial institutions registered as foreign exchange banks under Article 9 of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act may provide multi-currency clearing and wire services. EMIs may appear as an ancillary white-label user interface only if the underlying settlement and custody are fully executed by a licensed domestic Tier-1 bank; otherwise, the trust will face regulatory rejection, account freezing, and tax compliance issues.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person KYC is generally required for this high-risk fiduciary structure. South Korean financial institutions enforce the Real Name Financial Transactions Act and the Financial Transactions Reports Act, which obligate the bank to identify the statutory directors and the ultimate beneficial owner before opening any account. A remote consular proxy opening is not a standard pathway; the bank may accept a notarized and apostilled power of attorney for a Korean resident agent, but a live video interview with the responsible compliance officer will still be mandatory. For the highest risk tiers, most Tier-1 Korean banks require at least one face-to-face meeting with an authorised signatory in a domestic branch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trust purpose is described as discretionary asset protection, which triggers financial crime typologies of concealment, asset stripping, and spendthrift protection in a high-risk fiduciary context.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Original executed trust deed; a fiduciary law opinion from a licensed Korean attorney; loan or trade documentation proving the legitimate commercial purpose; an independent audit trail of the trust settlement sum; and a trustee declaration that the arrangement does not violate creditor-protection statutes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-layered corporate chain without a single controlling entity, making customer due diligence unable to identify the natural persons with ultimate control.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Organisational chart, certificates of incumbency for each layer, register of directors and shareholders, 25-plus-percent UBO declarations, certified passport or identity copies for all signatories, official registry extracts from every jurisdiction, and a deed of trust explaining control and veto rights.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of wealth is unsupported by verifiable financial records, or original funding originates from unrelated third parties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank statements covering at least 24 months, wealth accumulation letters, purchase or sale agreements, inheritance or gift certificates, income and corporate tax returns for the settlor and beneficiaries, audited financial statements of the funding company, and an independent accountant’s source-of-wealth opinion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, politically exposed persons, or low-tax jurisdiction nexus involving settlors, beneficiaries, or counterparties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal sanctions and PEP screening results from reputable data providers, negative news and reputational due diligence reports, either FATCA or CRS self-certifications for every reporting person, and a Korean law legal opinion confirming the transaction is not tax evasion or money laundering.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound foreign direct investment for Yuhan Hoesa must be routed via SWIFT MT103 to an account held at a domestic foreign exchange bank under the Foreign Investment Promotion Act. The remitter must quote FX purpose code 110101 (foreign direct investment) and the beneficiary must deposit funds into a Foreign Investor Deposit Account before any conversion to Korean won. After the inward remittance notification, the company files a foreign investment report through the bank or KOTRA system; an external auditor then performs capital verification and issues a certificate of investment to enable registration of the trust-funded equity or capital contribution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound disbursements, SWIFT MT103 is appropriate for ordinary fee and service payments, while commercial letters of credit are mandatory for tangible goods requiring transport documentation, and documentary collections are acceptable for sales on bill of exchange. All outgoing wires must state the correct FX purpose code such as 210101 for import payments, include invoice and contract identifiers, and clear through a licensed domestic foreign exchange bank. The bank will require proof of the underlying trade contract for high-value outflows, and for LC issuance the trust must provide margin cover or an approved credit facility.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore Korean won forward contracts permitted for genuine trade and investment hedging, executed through licensed domestic foreign exchange banks and reported under FETA

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) allowed only for real underlying won exposure when executed through a Korean foreign exchange bank or an approved offshore counterparty with strict underlying exposure verification
Currency swaps with licensed commercial banks for matching foreign-currency assets and liabilities, restricted to real economic exposures and prohibited for speculative arbitrage

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporation Tax Return and Local Income Tax Surtax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Tax Service (NTS), Seoul Regional Tax Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By 31 March of the following tax year (3 months from fiscal year end); interim corporate tax prepayment due 31 August and 30 November for entities with financial or fiduciary income
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the return is omitted or understated, a surcharge equal to 10% of the unreported tax is imposed, increased to 40% for fraudulent concealment; overdue tax accrues daily late payment interest of 0.025% per day (approx. 9.1% per annum); repeat violations lead to forced tax collection, seizure of assets, and criminal indictment under the Punishment of Tax Evaders Act.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Financial Statements Approval and Registry Registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local District Court Registry (Commercial Registration Section, Ministry of Court Administration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be approved by the members' general meeting within 6 months after the fiscal year end (by 30 June for a calendar year), and the approved financial statements and resolution excerpt must be filed with the court registry within 14 days after approval.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: An administrative fine of up to KRW 3,000,000 (approx. USD 2,222) may be imposed for violation of Article 557 of the Korean Commercial Act; if filings are omitted for 3 consecutive years, the court may order dissolution of the Yuhan Hoesa, followed by administrative strike-off from the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Semi-Annual Value Added Tax (VAT) Returns (First and Second Half)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: First half of fiscal year (1 January - 30 June) due on 25 July; second half (1 July - 31 December) due on 25 January of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file VAT carries a surcharge of 20% of the unpaid tax (10% for understatement); unpaid VAT accrues 0.025% daily late interest; habitual non-filing can cause administrative cancellation of the business registration (corporate identity impaired).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Trust Business Annual Operations Report and Fiduciary Financial Accounts Statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) and Financial Services Commission (FSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year end (by 31 March for calendar year); supplementary five-year trust business plan update due by 31 May.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing triggers administrative warning, suspension of the trust business license for up to 3 months, and, for repeated violations, revocation of the license under Article 33 of the Korean Trust Act; the entity is also removed from the FSC's licensed trust company register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Anti-Money Laundering (AML) / Counter-Financing of Terrorism (CFT) Compliance Report and Beneficial Ownership Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU) under the Financial Services Commission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual AML report and UBO confirmation must be filed by 31 March; any change in beneficial ownership (10% or more) must be reported within 30 days of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Omission or incorrect submission attracts administrative fines up to KRW 50,000,000 (approx. USD 37,037); willful misrepresentation is punishable by imprisonment of up to 5 years and fines of up to KRW 100,000,000 under the Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent audit by a certified public accountant (CPA) is required when: (a) the Yuhan Hoesa holds a trust business license under the Korean Trust Act and administers discretionary asset protection trusts, regardless of size; (b) total assets at the preceding fiscal year end equal or exceed KRW 12 billion (approx. USD 8.9 million); (c) annual turnover equals or exceeds KRW 10 billion (approx. USD 7.4 million) with an average headcount of 100 or more; (d) the company is designated by the Financial Services Commission as requiring external audit for public interest or investor protection, or (e) the company fails to meet small-company classification under the Act on External Audit of Corporations. Trust companies under FSC supervision must always present audited financial accounts under the FSC's Financial Statements and Audit Rules.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Korean International Financial Reporting Standards (K-IFRS) as mandated by the Korean Accounting Standards Board for financial companies, including licensed trust companies, and large corporations; Korean SMEs employing K-GAAP (Korean Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, simplified KASB SME Standards) may adopt K-IFRS for consolidated subsidiaries; trust accounts must additionally follow the FSS 'Trust Business Account Standards' and the Korean Trust Act's accounting and segregation rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: South Korea applies a real-owner (beneficial owner) registration duty under the Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information and the Act on Real Name Financial Transactions. For the Yuhan Hoesa, every person who directly or indirectly owns 10% or more of its capital, or who controls the company through a discretionary trust arrangement, must be identified. The trust entity must file a UBO confirmation to KoFIU by 31 March each year; any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be reported to KoFIU within 30 days of the event. In addition, the company's statutory registers must be updated at the same time and the private transparency measures of the Commercial Act dictate that transfers of member (quota) interests in a Yuhan Hoesa are effective upon entry in the Register of Members and notification to the company; the company must then update the registry if the transfer affects control.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Register of Charges/Mortgages, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 - USD 1,600 per year (registered office outsourcing and corporate secretarial agent fees in Seoul)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 15,000 - USD 40,000 per year for a licensed trust company with a discretionary asset protection line; CPA audit fees for an ordinary SME Yuhan Hoesa would range from USD 5,000 - USD 15,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22% national corporate income tax plus 10% local income tax surcharge, aggregating to a top effective marginal rate of 24.2%
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general preferential free-zone rate applies to fiduciary asset protection trusts; eligible R&D expenditures may qualify for super deductions of 10-30%; certain financial-sector activities may enjoy temporary tax credit incentives, but ordinary trust fee income remains subject to the standard progressive corporate income tax schedule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (법인세과세표준및세액신고서, Form No. 21-2) filed electronically through HomeTax, the National Tax Service (NTS) portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months from the end of the fiscal year; a December 31 fiscal year-end requires filing by March 31 of the following year. A non-resident foreign corporation may apply for an extension where consolidated financial statements are required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 1 - Attached Business Report / Entity Identification
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification, corporate entity type, business year, fiscal year-end, registered address in Korea, and foreign ownership attributes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident-owned Yuhan Hoesa, enter the domestic tax representative's contact details and confirm the entity is classified as a taxable corporation. A foreign corporation with no Korean permanent establishment must use the non-PE filing path and report only Korean-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 5 / Box 1-1 - Gross Income and Domestic Business Income
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue, trust management fees, fiduciary income, and other business receipts sourced within Korea.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose trust-related fee income separately from custodial income. If the discretionary trust exercises core income-generating activities through Korean employees or a Korean office, the Yuhan Hoesa will be deemed to have a Korean permanent establishment and must allocate Korean business profits accordingly. No deduction is allowed for discretionary principal distributions to settlers unless such amounts constitute genuine deductible business expenses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 9 - Special Tax Treatment and Deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjustments under special tax laws, including income deductions and tax credits claimed by the entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident corporations may not claim R&D credits for activities performed wholly outside Korea. If asset protection trust income is exempt under a double tax treaty, attach a separate schedule referencing the relevant DTA article. Grantor-trust income attributable to a Korean resident beneficiary must be reported on the beneficiary's schedule and cannot be deducted at the entity level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 12 - Tax Base and Standard Tax Amount
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computed taxable income after prior-year loss carryforwards, deductions, and tax-free reserves.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply loss carryforwards only if the five-year temporal limitation is satisfied. A Korean Yuhan Hoesa may not reduce taxable income by distributions to a foreign settlor; controlled foreign corporation and anti-deferral rules may attribute trust income directly to Korean shareholders, requiring gross-up computations on the beneficiary's side.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, domestic withholding credits, instalment payments, and withholding taxes withheld by Korean payers on Korean-source income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the applicable foreign tax credit schedule where foreign withholding tax is claimed. Korean-source income withheld at the source rate may be credited against the final corporate tax liability only if the underlying income is included in the taxable base. For U.S.-classified grantor trusts, Korea may require a beneficiary-level look-through report to prevent double non-taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of foreign corporation status, including a signed certification that the entity does not have a Korean permanent establishment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete this box only if the Yuhan Hoesa has no Korean office, place of management, dependent agent, or fixed facility. Negotiating or concluding contracts in Korea through an agent employee, engaging in a construction site for more than six months, or maintaining a fixed place of business will void the non-PE certification. Wrongful certification triggers a 20% understatement penalty plus interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a negligence penalty of 20% of the unpaid tax, or 0.07% of the tax base when no tax is due, plus a daily overdue charge of 0.0225% on unpaid tax. Omission of income above KRW 10 billion may constitute criminal tax fraud. Failure to furnish transfer pricing documentation incurs fixed penalties from KRW 10 million to KRW 50 million. Failure to report foreign financial accounts may be subject to a penalty up to 20% of the unreported amount and criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 22% on outbound dividends to non-resident shareholders: 20% dividend withholding tax plus 10% local surtax on the withholding base.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim double tax treaty relief, the non-resident must file the 'Application for Tax Withholding Exemption/Reduction under a Tax Treaty' using the HomeTax portal before the payment date, attach the home-state tax authority's Tax Residency Certificate (TRC), and provide a beneficial ownership statement confirming the claimant is the actual owner of the dividend, interest, or royalty and does not pass the income to a resident of a third state. The Korean withholding agent must retain the application, apply the reduced withholding rate, and include the treaty-exempt amount on the monthly withholding tax return. Without the TRC and beneficial ownership substantiation, the full 22% statutory rate must be withheld.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: statutory 22% (20% base plus 10% surtax on that base), commonly reduced to 0-10% under Korea's bilateral income tax treaties. Royalties: statutory 22% (20% base plus 10% surtax on that base), generally reduced to 5-15% under applicable DTA royalty provisions, subject to the beneficial ownership clause.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File must be prepared when intercompany transactions between the Korean entity and foreign related parties exceed KRW 10 billion in the tax year. Master File is required when aggregate revenue exceeds KRW 100 billion and cross-border related-party transactions exceed KRW 10 billion. Country-by-Country Report notification follows separate CbC filing thresholds.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: South Korea does not operate a dedicated Economic Substance Regulations regime like forum jurisdictions, but substance is assessed under the International Tax Adjustment Act using substance-over-form, principal purpose, and controlled foreign corporation rules. Where a discretionary asset protection trust has no real office, employees, core income-generating activities (CIGA), or decision-making functions in Korea, the trust may be disregarded and its income reattributed to the Korean settlor or beneficiaries. All trust administration must retain board minutes, trust deeds, KYC files, AML/CDD records, and client due diligence for at least five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion through Unreported Offshore Trust Income
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Yuhan Hoesa receives an irrevocable offshore trust distribution for the economic benefit of Korean residents but does not report the income on the corporate tax return; SWIFT wire records evidence transfers to Korean bank accounts while the Korean settlor retains effective control of the trust.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Article 8 of the Punishment of Tax Evasion Act, imprisonment of 3 to 5 years plus a fine up to 10 times the tax evaded, and a maximum fine of KRW 100 million. The NTS may additionally levy a 40% negligence penalty under the Framework Act on National Taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: the managing director is jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, surcharges, and penalties. The NTS may impose a travel ban, blacklist the director, attach personal bank accounts, and seize personal assets. Criminal conviction carries 3-5 years' imprisonment, and amounts exceeding KRW 300 million may yield a sentence of 5 years or more.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The discretionary asset protection trust has no genuine management in Korea, no operating substance, and is used merely to shield Korean assets while the trustee issues fictitious fiduciary invoices to Korean service companies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-characterization as a sham trust under the International Tax Adjustment Act results in treaty benefit denial, tax reassessment, and a 38% understatement penalty. Filing a false written declaration may trigger corporate fines of up to KRW 50 million under the Act on Special Cases Concerning Anti-Corruption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors involved in establishing a sham trust are personally exposed to joint and several liability for all taxes owed by the Korean settlor, personal asset freezes, foreign travel restrictions, and civil restitution of assets moved out of Korea. Criminal prosecution for obstruction of tax levy may lead to imprisonment up to 5 years and judicial confiscation of trust assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Yuhan Hoesa administers discretionary trusts for foreign clients without the statutory fiduciary license required under the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act or without registering as a reporting entity with the Korea Financial Intelligence Unit (KoFIU).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Failure to report suspicious transactions under Article 8-2 of the Act on Proceedings for Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information is punishable by a fine up to KRW 30 million and administrative sanctions. Unlicensed trust business is prohibited and may constitute criminal conduct.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The chief executive officer and compliance director face willful blindness liability under Korean AML law. KoFIU may refer the matter to prosecution, resulting in imprisonment up to 5 years and corporate fines up to KRW 50 million. The corporate license may be revoked and directors may face a 10-year industry disqualification.
